description: Unit test code for X25519 elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman function, including test vectors, small order checks, iterative tests, and Wycheproof test vector validation.

methods.name: TestVector
methods.description: Tests X25519 with known test vectors from RFC 7748.

methods.name: SmallOrder
methods.description: Checks behavior with small order point, expecting failure.

methods.name: Iterated
methods.description: Performs repeated X25519 operations to verify consistency.

methods.name: DISABLED_IteratedLarge
methods.description: Performs large iteration count test (disabled by default).

methods.name: Wycheproof
methods.description: Validates X25519 implementation against Wycheproof test vectors.
